features: Adds dedicated Automatic Scoring Test dashboard with secure per-judge browser URLs
Judges can save draft scores and Submit & Lock from their own test browser link
Automatic Test dashboard shows judge progress and submission status and can regenerate secure links
Automatic random scoring now simulates judge-session submissions instead of Manual admin score entry
Adds delete-one and delete-all controls for test judges and competitors plus Clear Entire Test Round
Adds Manage Test Data screen so Manual Test rounds can also delete judges and competitors individually or in bulk
Automatic and Manual Test calculations continue through the shared BDC scoring engine; only input workflow differs
All new judge sessions and marks remain isolated in bdc_test_* storage and cannot publish official BDC points
No Staging or Production deployment performed
